column3: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column2: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column3: to develop the educational, economical, religious,
cultural  and  social  needs  of  the  members  of  our
organizaion  and  to  the  low  income  families
including  the  needy  people,  act  in  the  disaster
situations  and  creating  the  feeling  of  positive
thinking among the public to achieve the expected
benefits;
to  attend  activities  on  religious  development  and
the development of the persons;
implementation of  activities leading to educational
development;
to promote values and morals;
to make awareness of Sinhala, English and Sanskrit
and  other  languages,  computer  and  technical
knowledge among school children, student monks
in Pirivenas and elderly people;
to implement religious and cultural programmes;
to contribute to social welfare;
to implement programmes to assist the disabled and
elderly  people;
to develop, protect and conservation of our temple
and its other associated temples and those monks;
to develop areas that should be developed; and
to  perform  all  other  things  that  are  incidental  or
appropriate for the fulfillment of the objectives of
the Corporation stated above.
